title: Minimum Average Difference Index
description: For each index `i`, compute the absolute difference between the integer average of elements `0..i` and the integer average of elements `i+1..n-1`. Use floor division; the right average is 0 when the right side is empty. Return the smallest index with the minimum difference. Input: `nums`. Output: the selected index.
hints: Sort or count values once, then process each candidate in a single pass.
Check duplicates, all-equal inputs, and boundary values for `k`.
